title: Countdown
scenario: Print the countdown from n down to 1, including 1.

intro.job: Print the countdown from n down to 1, including 1.

idea.rule: range stops BEFORE the end — counting down to 1, you have to say 0.
idea.detail: range(start, stop, step) hands out numbers from start up to — but never including — stop, stepping by step each time. Counting down, range(n, 0, -1) hands out n, n - 1, … down to 1: the stop 0 is never handed out, so 1 is the last number. When the last number matters, the stop has to be one past it — here, one BELOW it: 0.

watch.code:
out = []
for i in range(m, 0, -1):
    out.append(i)
print(out)

model_restatement: Make the list n, n - 1, … 1 — including 1 itself — and print it.

clarify.question: Could n be 0?
clarify.answer: Today n is always at least 1.

clarify.question: How should I give the countdown?

clarify_fallback: Good question — assume the simple case.
blueprint: Count down from n to 1. Put each number in a list, then print the list.
draft_code:

checkpoints.prompt: First time through the loop — what is i?
The loop has finished. What is i now?
With the fix — when the loop has finished, what is i?

why_line: range(n, 1, -1) stops before 1 — with n = 5 the last i is 2, so 1 never makes it into the list.

explain.rule: range(n, 1, -1) is a ticket roll that ends one ticket early — it hands out 5 down to 2, and 1 never comes off the roll.
explain.bridge: So what stop value would let 1 through?

fix.rule: range(n, 0, -1): start at n, stop just past 1 — so 1 itself is the last ticket.

walk.gloss: An empty list for the countdown.
Hand out n, n - 1, … down to 1 — the stop is 0, one past the end.
Add this number to the list.
After the last number, show the list.

fix.recommended:
nums = []
for i in range(n, 0, -1):
    nums.append(i)
print(nums)

alternatives.note: The shortcut — once you can trace the long way.

hints: When the loop ends, what's the last i?
range stops before its second number — even counting down.

follow_up.fix_hint: Nothing to change — range(1, 0, -1) hands out just the 1.
